instruction.hanzi: 读一读，说说这些词语是什么意思。
instruction.english: Read the words and phrases aloud and say what they mean.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 大家都做完了吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zuòwán le ma?
dialogue.english: Has everyone finished?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 做完了。老师，第一题我不懂。
dialogue.pinyin: Zuòwán le. Lǎoshī, dì yī tí wǒ bù dǒng.
dialogue.english: Yes. Ms. Liu, I don't understand question one.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 有什么问题？
dialogue.pinyin: Yǒu shénme wèntí?
dialogue.english: What's the problem?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 这个字我不认识。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhège zì wǒ bú rènshi.
dialogue.english: I don't know this character.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 这是“离”字。“机场离这儿很远”的“离”。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì "lí" zì. "Jīchǎng lí zhèr hěn yuǎn" de "lí".
dialogue.english: This is 离, the 离 in "the airport is far from here".

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我看错了，我觉得是“高”字。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ kàncuò le, wǒ juéde shì "gāo" zì.
dialogue.english: I misread it. I thought it was 高.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 现在懂了吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Xiànzài dǒng le ma?
dialogue.english: Do you understand now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 懂了，谢谢老师！
dialogue.pinyin: Dǒng le, xièxie lǎoshī!
dialogue.english: Yes, thank you!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你好，你是王明吧？欢迎你！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, nǐ shì Wáng Míng ba? Huānyíng nǐ!
dialogue.english: Hello, you must be Wang Ming. Welcome!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 您好！我什么时候开始上班？
dialogue.pinyin: Nín hǎo! Wǒ shénme shíhou kāishǐ shàng bān?
dialogue.english: Hello! When do I start work?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 从下个星期一开始。
dialogue.pinyin: Cóng xià ge xīngqīyī kāishǐ.
dialogue.english: From next Monday.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 每天几点上班？
dialogue.pinyin: Měi tiān jǐ diǎn shàng bān?
dialogue.english: What time does work start each day?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你下午有时间，就从一点工作到五点，可以吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ xiàwǔ yǒu shíjiān, jiù cóng yī diǎn gōngzuò dào wǔ diǎn, kěyǐ ma?
dialogue.english: You're free in the afternoons, so work from one to five. Is that OK?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 可以。星期六也上班吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Kěyǐ. Xīngqīliù yě shàng bān ma?
dialogue.english: That's fine. Do I work on Saturdays too?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 不上班，星期六和星期日都休息。
dialogue.pinyin: Bú shàng bān, xīngqīliù hé xīngqīrì dōu xiūxi.
dialogue.english: No. Saturdays and Sundays are both days off.

newWords.english: to work, to do a job

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 安娜，你会跳舞吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Ānnà, nǐ huì tiào wǔ ma?
dialogue.english: Anna, can you dance?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 会一点儿。我从小就喜欢跳舞。
dialogue.pinyin: Huì yìdiǎnr. Wǒ cóng xiǎo jiù xǐhuan tiào wǔ.
dialogue.english: A little. I've loved dancing since I was small.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 星期六晚上学校有舞会，你去吗？
dialogue.pinyin: Xīngqīliù wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu wǔhuì, nǐ qù ma?
dialogue.english: There's a dance at school on Saturday night. Are you going?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 去！我希望马克也去。
dialogue.pinyin: Qù! Wǒ xīwàng Mǎkè yě qù.
dialogue.english: Yes! I hope Mark goes too.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 他说他不会跳舞。
dialogue.pinyin: Tā shuō tā bú huì tiào wǔ.
dialogue.english: He says he can't dance.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 没关系，我教他！
dialogue.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒ jiāo tā!
dialogue.english: No problem, I'll teach him!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 星期六晚上，我和安娜去学校跳舞。
dialogue.pinyin: Xīngqīliù wǎnshang, wǒ hé Ānnà qù xuéxiào tiào wǔ.
dialogue.english: On Saturday night, Anna and I went to the school dance.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我不会跳舞，安娜从七点开始教我。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì tiào wǔ, Ānnà cóng qī diǎn kāishǐ jiāo wǒ.
dialogue.english: I can't dance, so Anna started teaching me at seven.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 开始的时候，我常常跳错。
dialogue.pinyin: Kāishǐ de shíhou, wǒ chángcháng tiàocuò.
dialogue.english: At first I kept getting the steps wrong.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 安娜说：“没关系，我们再来！”
dialogue.pinyin: Ānnà shuō: "Méi guānxi, wǒmen zài lái!"
dialogue.english: Anna said, "Never mind, let's try again!"

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 九点的时候，我会跳了！
dialogue.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn de shíhou, wǒ huì tiào le!
dialogue.english: By nine o'clock, I could dance!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 我希望下个星期还能和她跳舞。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng xià ge xīngqī hái néng hé tā tiào wǔ.
dialogue.english: I hope I can dance with her again next week.

explanation.hanzi: 动词后面加一个动词或形容词，说明动作有了什么结果，叫结果补语：做完（做了，现在没有了）、听懂（听了，明白了）、看错（看了，可是错了）、找到（找了，找着了）。否定的时候用“没（有）”，不用“不”：我没听懂。问的时候说“……了吗？”或者“……了没有？”。
explanation.english:
Chinese often adds a second word after a verb to show the result of the action. This is a result complement.
- 做完 do + finish = finished doing
- 听懂 listen + understand = understood (what was heard)
- 看错 look + wrong = misread, saw wrongly
- 找到 look for + reach = found
The verb says what you did; the complement says what came of it. 我找了 only means "I looked"; 我找到了 means "I found it".
Negative: use 没(有), not 不: 我没听懂 "I didn't understand". Questions: 你做完了吗? / 你做完了没有?

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuòwán le ma? — Zuòwán le.
examples.english: Have you finished? — Yes, I have.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō de huà, wǒ méi tīngdǒng.
examples.english: I didn't understand what the teacher said.

explanation.hanzi: “从”后面加时间或者地方，表示起点，意思是“从……开始”。“从……到……”说一段时间或者一段路的开始和结束。“从”和后面的词放在动词前面。
explanation.english:
从 marks a starting point in time or place: "from". The 从 phrase goes before the verb: 从美国来 "come from the US", 从八点开始 "start from eight".
Pair it with 到 to give both ends of a stretch of time or distance: 从一点到五点 "from one to five", 从我家到学校 "from my home to school".
从小 means "since childhood".

examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì cóng xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn kāishǐ.
examples.english: The exam starts at two in the afternoon.

examples.hanzi: 从我家到公司要四十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào gōngsī yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: It takes forty minutes from my home to the office.

examples.hanzi: 我从星期一到星期五都上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ dōu shàng bān.
examples.english: I work from Monday to Friday.

explanation.hanzi: “第”放在数词前面，表示次序：第一、第二、第三……。后面常常有量词和名词：第一个人、第三本书。“第二”和“两”不一样：“两个”说数量，“第二个”说次序。“题”前面可以不用量词：第一题。
explanation.english:
Put 第 in front of a number to make an ordinal: 第一 "first", 第二 "second", 第三 "third"...
A measure word and noun usually follow: 第一个人 "the first person", 第三本书 "the third book". Some nouns such as 题 and 天 can follow directly: 第一题 "question one", 第二天 "the second day / the next day".
Note: always 第二 for order, even though you say 两个 for quantity. 两个人 is "two people"; 第二个人 is "the second person".

examples.pinyin: Dì yī tí wǒ bù dǒng.
Tā shì dì yī ge dào jiàoshì de.
examples.english: He was the first one to get to the classroom.

examples.hanzi: 这是我的第三本汉语书。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de dì sān běn Hànyǔ shū.
examples.english: This is my third Chinese book.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dì èr tiān qùle jīchǎng.
examples.english: We went to the airport the next day.

prompt.hanzi: 两人一组，分角色读课文。
prompt.english: In pairs, read the dialogues aloud, taking one role each.

prompt.hanzi: 根据你的情况回答问题。

items.hanzi: 老师说汉语，你都听懂了吗？
items.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō Hànyǔ, nǐ dōu tīngdǒng le ma?
items.english: When the teacher speaks Chinese, do you understand everything?

items.hanzi: 你每天从几点到几点学习？
items.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān cóng jǐ diǎn dào jǐ diǎn xuéxí?
items.english: From what time to what time do you study each day?

items.hanzi: 你希望明年去哪儿旅游？
items.pinyin: Nǐ xīwàng míngnián qù nǎr lǚyóu?
items.english: Where do you hope to travel next year?

prompt.english: Fill in the blanks with 完, 懂, 错, 到, 从 or 第.

items.english: I'll go to work as soon as I've finished eating.
I didn't understand what the teacher said.
Sorry, I wrote this character wrong.

items.hanzi: 今天我是____一个到教室的。
items.english: Today I was the first to arrive in the classroom.

prompt.hanzi: 给问题选择合适的回答。
prompt.english: Match each question with a suitable answer.

items.hanzi: 你做完了吗？ — 还没做完。
items.pinyin: Nǐ zuòwán le ma? — Hái méi zuòwán.

items.hanzi: 你有什么问题？ — 第三题我不懂。
items.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme wèntí? — Dì sān tí wǒ bù dǒng.
items.english: What's your question? — I don't understand question three.

items.hanzi: 你什么时候上班？ — 从明天开始。
items.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou shàng bān? — Cóng míngtiān kāishǐ.
items.english: When do you start work? — From tomorrow.

items.hanzi: 我们去跳舞，好吗？ — 好啊！
items.pinyin: Wǒmen qù tiào wǔ, hǎo ma? — Hǎo a!

radicals.english: earth, soil (related to ground, places and building)
examples: 场 chǎng (field, as in 机场)

radicals.english: fire (four dots at the bottom; related to heat and fire)

prompt.hanzi: 两人一组，谈谈学习和工作。
prompt.english: In pairs, talk about study and work.

activities: Classroom check: one partner is the teacher and asks 做完了吗？ / 听懂了吗？ / 有什么问题？; the other answers with 做完了 / 没做完, 懂了 / 没听懂, and asks about a specific question (第……题).
Describe your weekly schedule with 从……到……: when you study, work (上班) and rest.
First-day welcome: greet a new classmate or colleague with 欢迎你！ and tell them when things start (从……开始).
Tell your partner three things you hope for this year with 我希望……
